question: Qual a média de dias de atraso dos pedidos entregues tardiamente para categorias com pedidos atrasados (pelo menos 1 atraso)?
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.category_name_pt, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS delayed_orders_count, 
    ROUND(AVG(o.delay_days), 1) AS avg_delay_days 
FROM marts.fct_orders o 
JOIN marts.fct_order_items oi 
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id 
JOIN marts.dim_products p 
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id 
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' 
  AND o.is_delayed = TRUE 
GROUP BY p.category_name_pt 
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 1 
ORDER BY delayed_orders_count DESC, avg_delay_days DESC 
LIMIT 5;
